acceptance_criteria: Exactly 9 route poses x 21 x 21 x/y cells = 3969 candidates are audited with exactly 2,857,680 horizontal and 11,907 vertical rays.
Every cell preserves solved sensor xyz, floor query and verification distances, horizontal clearance and feasibility decision.
Every pose preserves four-neighbour components; a robust recommendation requires at least three connected feasible cells and is the nearest such cell to the frozen pose.
Inference, graph updates, training, C09/C10/M-TARE reads are zero; logs, metrics, CSV, pose/group JSON, heatmaps and seal are complete.
Audit PASS means diagnostic evidence completeness; every pose having a robust feasible component is reported but is not required for evidence PASS.
baseline: The frozen centerline pose and the preceding z-only audit, which left 6/9 route poses unresolved. Fallback: if any physical region has no non-isolated feasible component, recommend S10 perception-mesh regeneration rather than deleting frames or lowering thresholds.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D only; expected seconds to minutes; zero GPU.

expected_evidence: 3969-row candidate CSV and nine pose component summaries.
Five physical-group heatmap figures with complete ±1m extents.
Aggregate and runner metrics, raw log, environment/tool/input hashes, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
method: At all nine sealed route failures, evaluate a 21x21 global x/y grid spanning ±1.0m at 0.1m spacing. At each cell solve sensor z from a downward floor query, verify 1.00±0.05m floor distance and >=0.8m upward clearance, then cast 720 world-horizontal rays. A robust trajectory candidate must belong to a four-neighbour feasible component containing at least three cells.
question: Can a local lateral x/y displacement with floor-following z make every localized S10 C08 low-clearance route pose satisfy the unchanged 0.8m safety contract in a non-isolated feasible region?
stop_conditions: Candidate/ray count mismatch, missing accepted evidence, lost route failure or evidence seal failure.
Any threshold change, trajectory write, inference, graph, training or C09/C10/M-TARE read.
